name: takt
description: Takt — lokale Todo- und Zeittracking-Anwendung mit konfigurierbarem Export (E-001).

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run boundaries && pnpm run contrast && pnpm run proof:all && pnpm run verify:bundle && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build
scripts.proof:all: pnpm run proof:codepoints && pnpm run proof:migrations && pnpm run proof:openapi && pnpm run proof:callers && pnpm run proof:conflicts && pnpm run proof:tags && pnpm run proof:access && pnpm run proof:export && pnpm run proof:export-api && pnpm run proof:taskpane && pnpm run proof:foreign && pnpm run proof:addin-wiring && pnpm run proof:route-policy && pnpm run proof:template-fields && pnpm run proof:db-permissions && pnpm run proof:addin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:test && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.typecheck:test: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/storage/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/export/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/local-api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/outlook-addin/tsconfig.test.json
